# Minimalist UX & Clean Showcase Checklist: Galería de Imágenes, Vitrina 360° y Proformas

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review checklist to enforce the "Menos es Más" (Minimalist & Professional) design principles on the public TikTok Live showcase, eliminating visual noise, bloated tutorial copy, and card clutter.  
**Created**: 2026-10-04  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [Constitución - Principio I: KISS & YAGNI](../../.specify/memory/constitution.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on user preferences and feature context.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Requirement Completeness & Clean Hierarchy

- [ ] CHK001 Are the requirements for the removal of the bloated tutorial hero banner explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-11]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the exact visual content of the minimal 1-line store header specified (Logo, Trade Name, Live indicator, WhatsApp button)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-11]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the essential data fields per product card strictly enumerated (Image, Name/Model, Warranty, Stock, Clean Price, Order Button) while excluding internal noise? [Completeness, Spec §FR-12]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for the single-row horizontal category filter bar with active/inactive states? [Coverage, Spec §FR-13]

## 2. Visual Clarity & "Menos es Más" Aesthetics

- [ ] CHK005 Is the "Apple Store / Clean Studio" photographic aesthetic for product image backgrounds quantified with specific neutral palette values (e.g. `#F8F9FA` / `#FFFFFF`)? [Clarity, Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the prohibition of internal technical noise (such as raw `SKU` identifiers and redundant `"Precio Especial"` prefixes) explicitly stated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-12]
- [ ] CHK007 Are badge sizing, character limits, and wrapping rules specified to prevent text truncation (such as `"1 año de garantí..."`) on mobile viewport widths (360px - 414px)? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the prominent price typography specified with clean Bolivianos formatting (`Bs. 3.000` or `Bs. 3.000,00`) without cluttering currency disclaimers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-12]

## 3. Interaction & Mobile Experience (TikTok Live)

- [ ] CHK009 Are mobile touch interaction guidelines defined for the 3D tilt effect so it feels subtle and responsive rather than disorienting? [Clarity, Spec §FR-14]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the turntable 360° modal trigger specified with a clean, non-intrusive pill button (`Girar 360°`) that does not obstruct the product cover? [Consistency, Spec §FR-14]
- [ ] CHK011 Are zero-result state requirements specified for search queries, offering a clean reset action without clutter? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK012 Are WhatsApp pre-filled order messages specified to remain concise, respectful, and direct without salesy bloat? [Consistency, Spec §FR-15]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
